task.title: Install to a motor with cooling ribs
task.shortdesc: This section describes the process of installing an to a motor with cooling ribs.

context.p: This section describes the process of installing an to a motor with cooling ribs.

fig.title: Process of installing an on a motor

context.p: To install an to a motor with cooling ribs:

step.cmd: Remove the four outer screws of the and remove the orange cover to verify that the batteries are installed.

info.p: Caution: Handle the device carefully to avoid damage to the battery or internal components.

step.cmd: Put the case back on. Ensure that the foam area covers the battery holder.

fig.title: Position of the orange before re-inserting the screws

step.cmd: Take the screws provided in the shipment box and insert them into the base plate. placeholder

info.p: Figure 39: Position of the screws on the

step.cmd: Screw the fixing clamps into the base of the .

info.p: Warning: Ensure that the clamps do not exceed the edge of the to avoid interference with other parts of the motor.
info.note: Install the clamps in such a way that the screws are on top for easy access during installation.

fig.title: Position of the clamps on the base of the
Clamps not exceeding the edge of the

step.cmd: Tighten the screws but do not completely tighten them at this time.
Loosely place the in the back-center area, as shown in the diagram on the SMS case:

info.note: Follow these indications regardless of whether the motor is in a vertical or horizontal position.

fig.title: Correct positioning of the - on the back center of the motor

info.note: As shown in the previous image, an must be positioned in the back third of the motor and the edges of the should be parallel to the cooling fins. For more information on the proper positioning of an , see Dos and don’ts.

step.cmd: Use a marker to mark the position of the clamps on the fins.

fig.title: Using a marker to mark the position of the clamps

step.cmd: Use sandpaper to sand both sides of the cooling fin where the clamps will mount to remove the paint. Preparing the surface will improve adhesion.

info.p: Caution: Wear gloves while handling sandpaper to avoid skin irritation. Use sandpaper gently to avoid damaging the cooling fins' surface.

fig.title: Using a sandpaper to remove paint

info.p: PPE Required: Wear gloves before preparing the adhesive. Mix the bi-component adhesive using the mixing tool.

step.cmd: Apply the adhesive generously on both sides of the cooling fin in the sanded area where the clamps are to be placed.

fig.title: Applying adhesive on both sides of the fin

step.cmd: Attach the to the cooling fins using the fixing clamps.
Tighten the screws on top of the clamps using a Hex Wrench. Use a Philips screwdriver to finish tightening the screws to secure the to the clamps.

fig.title: Tightening the screws on top of the clamps

info.p: Warning: Ensure that the is firmly attached before proceeding to avoid potential detachment during operation.

step.cmd: On the , confirm that the is installed by tapping Confirm sensor is mounted to begin the learning process.
